expired: That request expired; send the command again.
usage:
Usage:
/sh <command> — runs a Linux command in /uva
/py <code> — runs Python in /uva
/sh undo — puts /uva back to before the last command
/sh history — snapshots
/sh allowed — commands that run without asking (remove with /sh allowed remove <n>)
refused_invisible: 🚫 Not run: the command has invisible or bidirectional Unicode characters (a classic way to hide what it really does). Type it again by hand.
refused_floor: 🚫 Not run, not even with confirmation: {what}.

allowlist.empty: No always-allowed commands. They appear here when you tap "Always allow".
